prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid rooftop-patio portrait of an approved adult red-haired woman at night.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long wavy red hair and a contemplative upward gaze, standing casually beside a patio heater with hands in jacket pockets. She wears a white leather moto jacket, white top, matching white mini skirt, and silver rings.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level portrait with warm patio heater, string lights, city skyline, bistro tables and checkered chairs, potted plants, and rooftop guests softly blurred behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm heater and string-light glow against dark city night, soft shadows, inviting urban rooftop atmosphere, realistic leather and hair highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical candid portrait, shallow depth of field, sharp subject, realistic night bokeh, leather, metal, fabric, and skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical rooftop-patio portrait of an approved adult woman with long wavy red hair looking upward and slightly away with a contemplative expression. She stands casually beside a patio heater with hands in the pockets of a white leather moto jacket, wearing a white top, matching white mini skirt, and silver rings. Include warm string lights, city skyline, bistro tables, checkered chairs, potted plants, and softly blurred guests. Use warm inviting night light, soft shadows, realistic leather highlights, and shallow depth.
